topic: Regular exercise is good for your eyes too (general)

youtube.title: New Year goal: walk! Your eyes will thank you 🚶 #Shorts
youtube.description:
New Year goal: walk! Your eyes will thank you. 🚶
நடைப்பயிற்சி கண்களுக்கும் நல்லது!

• The retina and optic nerve need a steady blood supply.
• Exercise helps control diabetes and BP, which protects the eyes.
• Outdoor play in daylight helps lower the risk of short sight in children.
• Studies suggest active people have a lower risk of some eye diseases.
• Start small: 30 minutes a day, sunglasses in strong sun, and never look at the sun.
• Start 2027 with a family eye test.
